name: Manager Nakano
source: The manager of the "Burukon TT" store, which is an abode of the school swimsuits for the fetishists of all kinds. Nakano knows almost everything about the swimsuits. And if there is something he doesn't know, he can find it out with no problem. The manager is always ready to help those who loves the school swimsuits as much as he does.
